effective_mode_resolution: A current explicit Patrick instruction may set or override the mode within its stated scope.
A project-wide durable mode requires the installed runtime to read the current control-plane state object and establish readback/currentness.
Repository source presence alone does not establish all-chat activation.
Absent current mode evidence, fail to OFF rather than inventing activation.

behavior.ON: For substantive outputs, run the exact-answer-bound adversarial Countervoice pass and surface material objections as a HOSTILE REVIEWER blockquote.
